One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes, no time skips. Smooth gimbal, no shake. 35mm film look, soft natural grain.
CAST: @Image1 shows the exact product: a slim brushed-gold aluminium can with a thin black band and the word AURUM in tall black serif capitals, 'SPARKLING YUZU' below. It is the only product. It never moves, deforms or changes size; the AURUM lettering stays sharp and unchanged.
FIRST FRAME: extreme macro of the cold gold can surface covered in condensation, the letter A sharp, crushed ice and a halved yuzu blurred behind.
RULES: real physics; one camera path; bright Mediterranean morning sun, constant.
[0-6 s] The camera is already moving: it glides slowly sideways across the cold metal as a single droplet runs down past the lettering; light glints across the droplets.
[6-14 s] Without cutting, the camera pulls back smoothly at constant speed, revealing the whole can standing on crushed ice beside a halved yuzu; tiny bubbles of juice sparkle in the sun.
[14-22 s] The camera keeps pulling back and arcs gently to the left around the can, rising slightly; the background opens up into a white sunlit terrace and a sliver of turquoise sea; ice cubes glisten and slowly melt.
[22-30 s] The camera slows smoothly and settles exactly on the final composition: the can centred on the wet travertine ledge with the halved yuzu and ice, sea and white wall behind.
AUDIO: none.
No people, no hands, no text overlays, no extra cans, no logos besides AURUM.

One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes, no time skips. Smooth gimbal, no shake. 35mm film look, soft natural grain.
CAST: @Image1 shows the exact man: a man in his 50s with a long pale face, heavy dark brows, swept-back dark hair with silver temples and an enormous charcoal-black waxed handlebar moustache with two upturned spiral tips that completely covers his mouth; black turtleneck, dark charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, a small brass director's viewfinder on a brass chain. He stays exactly this man for the whole shot; his mouth is never visible.
FIRST FRAME: medium close shot of him on the edge of a tall old stone rooftop at dusk, raising the brass viewfinder to his eye, the city far below.
RULES: real physics; one camera path; the sky changes continuously from dusk to night like a time-lapse, never a cut. Epic, quiet, blockbuster-trailer feeling.
[0-6 s] The camera is already moving: a slow drift around him as he studies the horizon through the viewfinder, one brow raised; wind lifts the edge of his blazer.
[6-14 s] Without cutting, the camera rises and swings behind him in one smooth crane move; he lowers the viewfinder, then raises it again with calm certainty, like a director framing the whole city.
[14-22 s] The camera keeps craning up and away; the sky darkens to night and an enormous full moon rises behind him; the city lights below switch on in waves, as if on his cue.
[22-30 s] The camera settles exactly on the final composition: a low wide hero shot of his silhouette on the rooftop pillar against the giant moon, viewfinder raised, the glittering city below.
AUDIO: none.
No other people, no text, no logos, no costume look, no cartoon.
